pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Max Lange Attack, Krause Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nxc3 before Black's ...dxc3; rewritten as 7...dxc3 8.Nxc3. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Max Lange Attack, Loman Defense
pages.notes: needs-research: plan 1 plays fxg7 with no pawn on g7 (9...g6 moved it), but two rewrites were rejected (the reviewer could not confirm Qf3/Qe2, and Qg4 neither attacks the king nor stops ...O-O); old text kept and the reference added to the skips. Fixed: plan 2's 'central pawns (c4, d5)' (Black's pawns are on c4 and d4) and the overview, which now explains the pinned e6-bishop; British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: 4.d3 Be7 5.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2's route Nf3-e1-g3 is not a knight route; rewritten as Nbd2-f1-g3 after castling and Re1. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: 4.d3 Be7 5.O-O O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1's 'Knight's Tour Ng1-e2-g3' (the knight is on f3) rewritten around Re1 and Nbd2-f1-g3. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: 4.d3 Be7 5.O-O O-O 6.Bb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3 (it is the b1-knight, and only after Re1); plan 2 sent the c6-knight via e7, where the bishop stands (caught by the reviewer); plan 3's Bc2 needs c3 first. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: 4.d3 Be7 5.O-O O-O 6.Re1
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 wrote unreadable routes (c3-d4, b1 via d2-f1-g3); rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: 5.O-O Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Re1 pressing an e5-pawn that isn't there; the overview called 5...Nxe4 the Max Lange (it is 5...Bc5 6.e5). Rewritten around 6.e5 Ne4; British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Max Lange, 6.e5 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 called e6 a pawn (the bishop stands there); plan 2 had ...Qd7, ...O-O-O and an 'open c-file' that doesn't exist; rewritten around 9...Qd5 10.Nc3 Qf5 (the first rewrite claimed Qf5 holds f7, rejected and corrected). British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Italian Game: Scotch Gambit, Anderssen Attack, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 exploited 'the pin on the f6-knight' with no knight on f6; plan 3's ...h6 and ...g5 rewritten around castling short (the g5-bishop covers d8). Overview notes this.

pages.name: Italian Game: Scotch Gambit, Double Gambit Accepted
pages.notes: Plan 2's 'c3 to prepare d5' had no White d-pawn; rewritten around 6.Re1 d5 7.Bxd5 Qxd5 8.Nc3. Overview names the Anderssen Attack; British spelling.
